notes.title: Hotfix for world gen error
notes.content:
Fixed world gen rate limiting issue for those using official cloud services

Added info text in loading progress bar for how many world generation tasks remain

notes.title: Research, Tech Levels, Sandbox Mode
notes.content:
Crafting/construction overhaul
Implemented a crafting/construction system where you first specify the blueprint, then need to bring enough items to the blueprint to finish it. For now, only 2 out of 3 items are required to finish a craft/construction.

To start crafting a new item, click on the static object you wish to use as the crafting station, click the craft button, and specify the desired item name. The AI will run a plausibility check for the crafting station, a research check, and a tech levels check.

To start crafting a new static object, click the new blue static object icon. The AI will run a research check and tech levels check.

NPCs may also occasionally start new crafts/constructions as well as bring items to existing blueprints.

Research
Each world now comes pregenerated with a research tree. The research items are used as checks for whether you’re allowed to create a new item or static objects. You can activate up to 3 research items at once. Research progresses whenever an NPC does an action which the AI deems was related to the research.

Tech Levels
Each world now comes pregenerated with about 10 tech levels. Your tech level is determined by your existing static objects. You can gradually tech up by building more and more advanced objects.

Sandbox Mode
Sandbox mode can be toggled on or off at will. When toggled on, it allows free-form creation of items (via the plus button in an NPC inventory), static objects, and NPCs without plausibility checks.

Misc

 Added a console for cheat codes related to research
 Fixed bug where static object displayed survival bars

notes.title: Create new NPC, Emojis fix, and more
notes.content:
Notice: Old saves may break as a result of this update. If you must play an old save which is broken, please switch to the "Older Build" beta channel in the Steam settings for this game.

Gameplay

 Added create new NPC view, subject to the maximum NPCs limit (currently 7)
 Added logic to spawn initial NPCs with initial items
 Added the following functionality for clicked NPC: Delete long-term memory, delete short-term memory, delete agenda item, add/remove/edit item, regenerate item image, remove status effect, add short-term memory, add new prioritized task, rewrite entire agenda with instructions
 Added ability for player to use in-place action when overriding an NPC’s current action
 Added local image gen support for ComfyUI and a1111 API

UI

 Fixed emojis sometimes not showing correctly
 Changed the name of “OpenAI API” to “Local/Custom (OpenAI API)” because some people didn’t know what it was
 Added camera panning with the mouse when holding right click
 Added mouse zooming logic which anchors the zoom to the point of the cursor
 Added tips as clickable question marks in the log, clicked NPC view, and create NPC / Static Object views
 Fixed clicked NPC view not refreshing when survival bar value changed
 Added ability for player to edit location name

Misc

 Added tolerance for parsing corpses in case AI specifies a dead NPC without using the word corpse
 Added tolerance for parsing quoted names in case AI specifies an NPC by their nickname
 Fixed OpenAI API error when auto-generating world background
